submission.summary:
DOAC dose review for all 17 panel patients, all of whom are on a DOAC for nonvalvular AF (no valvular disease documented). CrCl calculated by Cockcroft-Gault from current age, most recent weight and creatinine (Sept 2026 labs).

CHANGED (13):
- pt-2001 Brooks (62, 104 kg, SCr 0.7, CrCl ~161): edoxaban not recommended if CrCl >95 → stopped edoxaban 60 mg daily, started apixaban 5 mg BID (0 reduction criteria).
- pt-2002 Raman (74F, 52 kg, SCr 1.4, CrCl ~29): rivaroxaban 20 → 15 mg daily.
- pt-2003 Novak (78, 78 kg, SCr 1.7, CrCl ~40) on dronedarone: dabigatran 150 → 75 mg BID (P-gp inhibitor + CrCl 30-50).
- pt-2004 Greene (81, 88 kg, current SCr 1.2): only 1 reduction criterion → apixaban 2.5 → 5 mg BID.
- pt-2007 Castillo on itraconazole (strong dual CYP3A4/P-gp inhibitor): apixaban 5 → 2.5 mg BID.
- pt-2008 Hale on clarithromycin (strong dual CYP3A4/P-gp inhibitor): apixaban 5 → 2.5 mg BID; return to 5 mg BID after the antibiotic course ends.
- pt-2009 Soto (75, 60 kg, SCr 2.2, CrCl ~25, CKD4): dabigatran 150 → 75 mg BID.
- pt-2011 Whitfield (78, 68 kg, SCr 1.5, CrCl ~39): edoxaban 60 → 30 mg daily.
- pt-2012 Mercer (68F, 88 kg, SCr 1.0, CrCl ~75): rivaroxaban 15 → 20 mg daily (was underdosed).
- pt-2014 Rhodes (72, 85 kg, SCr 1.2, CrCl ~67) on dronedarone: dabigatran 75 → 150 mg BID (no reduction needed when CrCl >50).
- pt-2015 Lindqvist (currently 79, 58 kg, SCr 1.0): only 1 criterion → apixaban 2.5 → 5 mg BID; flagged for reassessment at age 80 on 2026-10-15, when 2.5 mg BID will become correct.
- pt-2016 Quinn (82F, 125 lb = 56.7 kg): 2 criteria (age ≥80, weight ≤60 kg) → apixaban 5 → 2.5 mg BID.
- pt-2017 Doyle (76F, 61 kg, SCr 1.05, CrCl ~44): rivaroxaban 20 → 15 mg daily.

NO CHANGE (4): pt-2005 Voss (apixaban 2.5 BID correct — age 83 + 57 kg), pt-2006 Lee (rivaroxaban 20 mg, CrCl ~89), pt-2010 Tran (edoxaban 60 mg, CrCl ~92, ≤95), pt-2013 Ward (edoxaban 60 mg, CrCl ~75; the ≤60 kg 30 mg reduction applies to VTE, not NVAF).

No other medications were altered.
